in_hebrew.name: אברה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Avra is derived from the Hebrew word אבר (avar), which means 'breeze' or 'wind.' The name Avra is also related to the Hebrew word אב (av), which means 'father.' In the context of biblical names, Avra can be interpreted as 'God is the father.'

in_greek.name: Αβρα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Avra is derived from the Greek word αὔρα (aura), which means 'breath' or 'wind.' The name Avra can also be related to the Greek word πατήρ (pater), which means 'father.' In the context of biblical names, Avra can be interpreted as 'Father of all.'

in_latin.name: Avra
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Avra is derived from the Greek name Αβρα (Abra). The name Avra in Latin means 'breath' or 'wind,' and can also be related to the Latin word pater, which means 'father.'
